definitions.explanation: A tall evergreen tree native to Japan, widely used in construction and forestry. Also a common source of pollen allergies in Japan.

examples.english: Japanese cedars are common in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{杉|すぎ}⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: Cedar pollen is terrible in spring.
This house is built with cedar wood.

notes:
{杉|すぎ} (Japanese cedar or cryptomeria) is one of the most common trees in Japan and is extensively used in construction due to its straight grain and durability.

CULTURAL NOTES:
{杉|すぎ}⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧ (cedar pollen allergy) affects millions of Japanese people every spring. The extensive planting of {杉|すぎ} after WWII for forestry has made this a significant public health issue.

- {杉|すぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧ (cedar tree)
- ⟦{杉林|すぎばやし}→杉林：28260_sugibayashi⟧ (cedar forest)
- {杉|すぎ}⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧ (cedar pollen)
- {杉|すぎ}⟦{材|ざい}→材：noentry⟧ (cedar wood/lumber)
